 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News PCSO Lotto Results: No winner of P420M Ultra Lotto prize in Oct.20 draw 
 By GMA News Published October 20, 2026 10:16pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. No bettors took home the Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize of over P420 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on October 20, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Tuesday.
 The Ultra Lotto jackpot of P420,158,396.49 was left unclaimed after no bettor played the winning numbers of 56-45-52-54-39-32.
 According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot are 1 in 40,475,358 or approximately 0.00000247%.
 The last time someone won in Ultra Lotto was March 17 when a senior citizen who played lotto for the past 25 years became the sole winner of P100.331 million.

 There were also no correct guesses of the Super Lotto 6/49 winning combination of 48-01-23-15-26-40. The pot has reached P58,052,134.93.
 Winners remained elusive for Lotto 6/42 as no bettor selected the numbers of 20-26-30-42-15-07 that would have yielded the P10 million prize.
